title: The Income-tax Act, 1961
in_force: no: repealed. Section 536(1) of the Income-tax Act, 2025 reads "The Income-tax Act, 96] is hereby repealed" in the Gazette's OCR text (the year is garbled by the OCR; that it is the 1961 Act rests on the market register and the Act's own references to 'the repealed Income-tax Act'). Section 1(3) of the 2025 Act reads "Save as otherwise provided in this Act, it shall come into force on the Ist April, 2026" in the same OCR text.
verified_how: Read 2026-10-21 in https://archive.org/download/in.gazette.central.e.2025-08-21.265620/265620_djvu.txt (OCR of the Extraordinary Gazette of 21 August 2025; 1,654,335 bytes, sha256 1cef19b3ba133f13dec4e59e94df6d1f08f764fda897d377ea909cdd4e96862d): line 58-59 for s.1(3), line 45027 for s.536(1).
not_found_in_india_code: India Code's DSpace API returned no central record for this Act: queries on the title, and on act year 1961 with act number 43, returned only unrelated Acts (2026-10-21).
version_question: This Act was amended repeatedly before it was repealed. Which text to deposit (as enacted, or consolidated to its last day, 31 March 2026) is a decision for whoever sources it; no consolidated text was located.
text_held_back: No text fetched. Text of an Act of Parliament is conditional to reproduce (Copyright Act 1957 s.52(1)(q)(ii), as recorded in the-income-tax-act-2025/SOURCE-LICENSE.md; not re-verified here), the decision on that is open, and the repealed Act's own text has not been sourced.
